blocks.text: Two easy runs a week are enough to keep the base mileage up, in week 33 of the plan.
The migration is safe because every write goes to both databases, in week 33 of the plan.
Notes in the margin help me remember more of what I read, in week 33 of the plan.
Watering in the evening loses less to the sun than the morning does, in week 33 of the plan.
The long run moves to Saturday so Sunday can be a rest day, in week 33 of the plan.
We will cache the search results for an hour and nobody will notice, in week 33 of the plan.
